items.diversity_note: Uses a workplace setting and a lease-related move.
items.evidence_note: adjoining clearly describes an adjacent office, matching the neighboring sense.
items.sentence: The clinic moved into the adjoining office after the lease ended.

items.diversity_note: Uses a travel setting with parking and a hotel entrance, unlike the office example.
items.evidence_note: adjoining marks a garage next to the hotel, showing physical adjacency.
items.sentence: We parked in the adjoining garage and walked straight into the hotel lobby.

items.diversity_note: Uses a document-review setting and a quality judgment frame.
items.evidence_note: entirely modifies accurate to show full, complete extent in a normal editorial context.
items.sentence: The report was entirely accurate, so the editor published it without changes.

items.diversity_note: Uses a personal-choice context with a different predicate and no document-related language.

items.sentence: Her decision to move was entirely her own, and no one pushed her into it.

items.diversity_note: Uses a kitchen preparation frame and a chef setting.

items.diversity_note: Uses a shopping frame with a packaged ingredient instead of a restaurant scene.

items.sentence: At the market, she picked up a carton of bouillon for the risotto.

items.diversity_note: Uses a vacation-planning context with a booking action.
items.evidence_note: The month name is used as a time point for planning a trip, which fits the active sense.
items.sentence: We booked the cabin for december and left the city for a quiet week.

items.diversity_note: Uses a business-hours context with a duration phrase rather than travel.
items.evidence_note: The month name marks a real-world period on a business schedule, supporting the active sense.
items.sentence: The store will stay open late through december to handle the holiday rush.

items.diversity_note: Focuses on art and a museum setting rather than food or shopping.

items.diversity_note: Uses a nature process frame instead of a scheduled event.

items.diversity_note: Focuses on a routine clinic visit and a follow-up appointment.

items.diversity_note: Uses a household repair scene and a sibling subject role.

items.diversity_note: Uses an art-and-history context with an object noun.

items.diversity_note: Uses a personal learning context rather than a cultural exhibit.
items.evidence_note: german modifies lesson in an ordinary language-learning context, showing the adjective sense clearly.

items.diversity_note: Focuses on bodily sensation during exercise, not emotion or relationships.

items.diversity_note: Focuses on a retail product demonstration and warranty talk.

items.diversity_note: Focuses on interior design rather than clothing or events.

items.diversity_note: Uses a corporate board and appointment frame instead of a civic one.

items.diversity_note: Focuses on emotion control in a workplace-like sports setting.
